# FOID Foundation — Technical Reference

> foid.fun | Fluent Testnet (chain 20994) | Next.js 14 + Solidity + Goldsky + IPFS

## Project Overview

FOID Foundation is an on-chain platform for permanent meme culture. It has three interconnected systems:

1. **Loreboard** — A collaborative image board where users propose meme placements on a shared grid, vote on them democratically, and canonize winners permanently on-chain. Think r/place but with economic stakes and on-chain finality.
2. **Foid Mommy Terminal** — An AI-powered prayer ritual where users select an emotional state, converse with an empathetic AI ("Foid Mommy"), and submit a personalized prayer on-chain. Prayer streaks and history are tracked via smart contracts.
3. **MiFOID LiveNFT** — A single 1/1 ERC-721 NFT that auto-updates its metadata to reflect the latest finalized board state. It is a living artifact of whatever the community canonized.

The core thesis: memes are culture, culture deserves permanence, and permanence requires consensus. The Loreboard creates a mechanism where economic bidding + democratic voting determines what gets etched into an immutable on-chain manifest.

## Architecture

```
User (Browser)
  │
  ├─ Next.js Frontend (React 18, wagmi, RainbowKit)
  │   ├─ /board — Infinite canvas with zoom/pan, placement proposals, voting UI
  │   ├─ /pray — Foid Mommy terminal, feeling selector, prayer submission
  │   ├─ /enter — Boot sequence gate with animations
  │   ├─ /about — Project documentation
  │   └─ / — Landing page with music visualizer
  │
  ├─ API Routes (Next.js serverless)
  │   ├─ /api/proposals — Queries Goldsky subgraphs, resolves CIDs, joins voting data
  │   ├─ /api/votes — User vote history from Goldsky
  │   ├─ /api/manifest/latest — Reads finalized manifest from chain + IPFS
  │   ├─ /api/operator/finalize — Settles epoch on-chain (operator-only)
  │   ├─ /api/foid-mommy — OpenAI prayer generation
  │   └─ (14 more routes, see API section below)
  │
  ├─ Goldsky Subgraphs (3 instances)
  │   ├─ Board V1 (v2.0.2) — indexes PlacementProposed from LoreboardBoardV1
  │   ├─ Board V2 (v2.0.0) — indexes PlacementProposed from LoreboardBoardV2
  │   └─ Voting (v2.0.1) — indexes VoteCast, PendingPlacementRegistered, EpochFinalized
  │
  ├─ IPFS (Web3.Storage primary, Pinata fallback)
  │   ├─ Image uploads for placement proposals
  │   └─ Manifest JSON for finalized epochs
  │
  └─ Fluent Testnet (chain 20994)
      ├─ LoreBoardTreasury — escrow, finalization, refunds
      ├─ LoreboardBoardV2 — proposal entrypoint, CID storage
      ├─ LoreboardVotingV2 — time-windowed voting per placement
      ├─ LoreBoardManifestStore — on-chain manifest anchoring
      ├─ LoreboardLiveNFT — auto-updating 1/1 ERC-721
      ├─ Prayer Registry — on-chain prayer storage
      └─ Prayer Mirror — prayer streak/stats reader
```

## Smart Contracts

All contracts are deployed on Fluent Testnet (chain ID 20994, RPC `https://rpc.testnet.fluent.xyz`).

### Loreboard Contracts

| Contract | Address | Purpose |
|----------|---------|---------|
| LoreBoardTreasury | `0x4A777d8650b3FA2419377F4ffeF0EF8007151536` | Escrows proposal funds, settles winners/losers on epoch finalization, handles refunds |
| LoreboardBoardV2 | `0xE41B2D418C09Ea928E4F657ED2438f5D01472105` | Main board entrypoint, stores CID bytes, relays to Treasury and Voting |
| LoreboardVotingV2 | `0xEbf065A7ca3917BB5e669982e8C6954cC27A7075` | Rolling-window voting per placement, time-derived epochs, pluggable voting power |
| LoreBoardManifestStore | `0xeE469D8F9BB2Ace861AA689dE53c016871ad3D10` | Minimal on-chain anchor mapping epoch to manifest root + IPFS CID |
| LoreboardLiveNFT | `0x4b38ad556300fadd6cdc5a9b0b1870e63c0f14e3` | 1/1 ERC-721 with ERC-4906 metadata updates, tracks latest finalized epoch |
| OnePerPlacementVotingPower | `0xCCf0ac9c66a68FCb8c438C697EdA87D9766f1Be5` | v0 stub: every address has weight 1 for all epochs |

| Contract | Address | Purpose |

| VM Wrapper | `0x4031762fB8b5d3fcA168AA6555FfC666ED500DaD` | LoreVM computation wrapper |

| WETH | `0x3d38E57b5d23c3881AffB8BC0978d5E0bd96c1C6` | Wrapped ETH |

### Key Contract Functions

**LoreBoardTreasury:**
- `proposePlacement()` — Submit placement with full ETH escrow
- `finalizeEpoch(epoch, manifestRoot, cid, acceptedIds[], rejectedIds[])` — Settle epoch; winners' funds to treasury, losers refunded
- `sweepTreasury()` — Owner withdraws accumulated winner funds
- `withdraw()` — Users pull failed refund (fallback)

**LoreboardBoardV2:**
- `proposePlacement(x, y, w, h, bidPerCell, cidBytes)` — Propose board placement with CID
- `finalizeEpochInVoting(epochId)` — Relay to VotingV2 finalization (operator-only)

**LoreboardVotingV2:**
- `registerPlacement(placementId)` — Register placement for voting (derives epoch from time)
- `voteOnPlacement(placementId, support)` — Cast YES/NO vote
- `setEpochFinalized(epochId)` — Lock epoch (prevents further voting)

**LoreBoardManifestStore:**
- `anchor(epoch, root, cid)` — Owner anchors manifest for epoch
- `latest()` — Returns (epoch, manifestRoot, manifestCid)
- `get(epoch)` — Returns (root, cid) for specific epoch

**LoreboardLiveNFT:**
- `syncLatest()` — Permissionless update to latest epoch metadata
- `tokenURI(0)` — Returns dynamic JSON metadata for token 0

## Frontend Pages

### `/enter` — Gate
Animated boot sequence with particle effects and progress bar. Sets `foid_entered` cookie. Keyboard (Enter key) and click activation. Sounds via WebAudio oscillators (click thock, boot chime). Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.

### `/` — Landing
Hero page with Foid Mommy artwork, project description, and CTA buttons to /pray and /board. Lazy-loads MusicPanel with Butterchurn visualizer (23-track playlist, crossfade, shuffle/repeat). Vista/Frutiger Aero window aesthetic.

### `/pray` — Foid Mommy Terminal
1. User selects one of 10 emotional states (happy, calm, hopeful, stressed, sad, angry, tired, lost, guilty, pain)
2. Foid Mommy responds with personalized acknowledgment via OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini)
3. User provides more detail, Foid Mommy generates a custom prayer
4. Prayer is hashed and submitted on-chain to Prayer Registry
5. Streak tracking: current streak, longest streak, total prayers, 24-hour cooldown

### `/board` — Loreboard
Infinite zoomable canvas (0.1x to 10x scale) displaying proposed and canonized image placements. Desktop: mouse zoom/pan. Mobile: pinch-zoom with gesture hints.

Key interactions:
- **Propose**: Upload image to IPFS, select grid position/size (32px tile snapping, max 400 cells), set ETH bid per cell
- **Vote**: YES/NO on active proposals within 72-hour voting window
- **View**: Click any placement to see detail modal with metadata, vote tallies, countdown timer, status badge
- **Chat**: Real-time terminal chat via Supabase

Placement statuses: proposed (not yet in voting), voting (active 72h window), canonized (passed + finalized), expired (voting window passed), rejected.

### `/about` — Documentation
Tabbed content sections explaining the project, mechanics, prayer system, loreboard, and MiFOID. Glass panel UI.

### `/(app)/home` — Dashboard
Connected-wallet dashboard showing prayer stats, user's board placements with status badges, voting activity history, and claimable refunds for rejected proposals.

## Key Flows

### Image Proposal Flow
1. User uploads image to IPFS via `/api/ipfs-upload` (Web3.Storage or Pinata)
2. User calls `Board.proposePlacement(x, y, w, h, bidPerCell, cidBytes)` with ETH escrow
3. Treasury escrows the full bid amount
4. Voting contract registers placement with a vote window (current time + voteWindowSeconds)
5. Goldsky indexes `PlacementProposed` event
6. Placement appears on `/board` with "proposed" then "voting" status

### Voting Flow
1. User calls `VotingV2.voteOnPlacement(placementId, support)` (YES or NO)
2. Voting power pulled from OnePerPlacementVotingPower (currently 1 weight per address)
3. Goldsky indexes `VoteCast` event
4. Frontend polls `/api/proposals` to show updated tallies

### Epoch Finalization Flow
1. Worker/cron triggers `scripts/auto-finalize-cron.ts` or `POST /api/operator/finalize`
2. Operator reads proposals from Goldsky, checks quorum and 51% majority
3. Overlap detection: higher bids displace lower bids for contested cells
4. Optional LoreVM (on-chain Wasm) computes winners; falls back to JS logic
5. Manifest JSON uploaded to IPFS with accepted placements
6. `Treasury.finalizeEpoch()` — winners' ETH goes to treasury, losers refunded
7. `ManifestStore.anchor(epoch, root, cid)` — on-chain finality anchor
8. `LiveNFT.syncLatest()` — NFT metadata updates to reflect new board state

### Prayer Flow
1. User selects emotional state on `/pray`
2. `POST /api/foid-mommy` with `feelingText` — returns AI acknowledgment + follow-up question
3. User responds, second `POST /api/foid-mommy` with `userResponse` — returns transition + custom prayer
4. User submits prayer on-chain to Prayer Registry contract
5. Prayer Mirror contract tracks streaks and totals

## API Routes

| Route | Method | Purpose | External Dependencies |
|-------|--------|---------|----------------------|
| `/api/health` | GET | Health check with memory metrics | None |
| `/api/status` | GET | Current epoch, seconds left, latest finalized manifest CID | Chain RPC, ManifestStore contract |
| `/api/proposals` | GET | All placements with voting data, CIDs, and status | Goldsky (3 subgraphs), chain multicall, IPFS |
| `/api/votes` | GET | Vote history for an address | Goldsky voting subgraph |
| `/api/manifest/latest` | GET | Latest finalized manifest from chain with IPFS resolution | Chain RPC, IPFS gateways (5 fallbacks) |
| `/api/manifest` | GET | Manifest for specific epoch (in-memory store) | None |
| `/api/propose` | POST | Create proposal (generates chainId, sets vote window) | IPFS gateways |
| `/api/place` | POST | Submit placement intent (ephemeral) | None |
| `/api/vote` | POST | Cast demo vote on proposal | None |
| `/api/mempool` | GET | List pending placement intents | None |
| `/api/cid-by-id` | GET | Lookup IPFS CID by proposal ID | None |
| `/api/ipfs/[cid]` | GET | Proxy IPFS file via gateway | IPFS gateway (Pinata) |
| `/api/ipfs-upload` | POST | Upload image to IPFS (max 5MB, png/jpeg) | Web3.Storage or Pinata |
| `/api/foid-mommy` | POST | AI prayer generation (two-turn conversation) | OpenAI gpt-4o-mini |
| `/api/finalize` | POST | Finalize epoch in-memory with IPFS manifest upload | IPFS |
| `/api/operator/finalize` | POST | Finalize epoch on-chain (operator-only, writes to Treasury + ManifestStore) | Chain RPC, IPFS, contracts |
| `/api/voting/bootstrap` | POST | Register placements for voting, configure epochs (admin-only) | Chain RPC, Voting contract |
| `/api/vanity-deploy` | POST | Generate vanity salt for predictable contract address | None |

## Automation

### Worker Scripts (`scripts/`)

- **loreboard-worker.ts** — Main worker: syncs proposals from chain logs, evaluates quorum/majority, detects overlaps, calls `finalizeEpoch` and `anchor` on-chain
- **auto-finalize-cron.ts** — Cron-safe wrapper: checks if finalization is needed, spawns operator finalize. Run via `npm run auto:finalize`
- **operatorFinalize.ts** — Direct epoch finalization with on-chain verification and manifest upload
- **sync-live-nft.ts** — Calls `LoreboardLiveNFT.syncLatest()` to update NFT metadata
- **verify-latest-manifest.ts** — Validates manifest integrity
- **recover-stuck-refunds.ts** — Refund recovery for failed push refunds

Suggested cron: `0 */6 * * * npm run auto:finalize`

### X Bot (`foid_bot/src/`)

Monitors on-chain events and posts observational tweets.

- **index.ts** — Main loop: load state, query Goldsky, classify events, generate tweet, post, save state
- **goldsky.ts** — GraphQL queries for PlacementProposed, VoteCast, EpochFinalized since last check
- **personality.ts** — OpenAI gpt-4o-mini with system prompt: lowercase, dry wit, observational, under 220 chars, no emojis/hashtags
- **twitter.ts** — Wraps twitter-api-v2 with `postTweet(text)` function
- **state.json** — Persists lastCheckedTimestamp, daily tweet timestamps, posted event IDs

Rate limits: max 6 tweets/day, minimum 2 hours between tweets.
Event priority: canonization > epoch finalized > vote surge (5+ votes) > new proposal > quiet observation (if 6+ hours idle).

Run: `npx tsx foid_bot/src/index.ts` from project root.

## Data Layer

### Goldsky Subgraphs

Project ID: `cmkwd7dgh0bq501z7fog65iag`

| Subgraph | Version | Endpoint | Contract | Events Indexed |
|----------|---------|----------|----------|----------------|
| Board V1 | 2.0.2 | `.../foid-loreboard-fluent-testnet/2.0.2/gn` | `0x16e1bB93...6013` (LoreboardBoardV1) | PlacementProposed, OperatorUpdated |
| Board V2 | 2.0.0 | `.../foid-loreboard-fluent-testnet/2.0.0/gn` | `0xE41B2D41...4105` (LoreboardBoardV2) | PlacementProposed, OperatorUpdated |
| Voting | 2.0.1 | `.../foid-loreboard-fluent-testnet/2.0.1/gn` | `0xEbf065A7...7075` (LoreboardVotingV2) | VoteCast, PendingPlacementRegistered, EpochFinalized, QuorumUpdated |

Base URL: `https://api.goldsky.com/api/public/project_cmkwd7dgh0bq501z7fog65iag/subgraphs/`

All start at block 15,774,936 on `fluent-testnet`.

### Indexed Entity Fields

**PlacementProposed**: id, idParam (bytes32 contract ID), bidder, epoch, x, y, w, h, cells, bidPerCellWei, cidHash, block_number, timestamp_, transactionHash_

**VoteCast**: id, epochId, placementId, voter, support, weight, block_number, timestamp_, transactionHash_, contractId_

**PendingPlacementRegistered**: id, epochId, placementId, registeredAt, voteEndsAt

**EpochFinalized**: id, epochId, block_number, timestamp_, transactionHash_

### CID Resolution Strategy

The frontend resolves IPFS CIDs from on-chain `cidHash` in three tiers:
1. **Chain multicall** — Batch `cidOf(bytes32)` calls to ManifestStore or Board contracts (fast)
2. **Calldata parsing** — Decode `proposePlacement()` transaction input data (slow, reliable)
3. **Null** — CID unresolvable

Results are cached 30 minutes per placement.

### IPFS Gateways

Upload: Web3.Storage (primary), Pinata (fallback). Retry with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s).

Read (multi-gateway fallback sequence):
1. Custom gateway (`NEXT_PUBLIC_IPFS_GATEWAY_BASE`)
2. `https://ipfs.io`
3. `https://dweb.link`
4. `https://gateway.pinata.cloud`
5. `https://w3s.link`
6. `https://4everland.io`

Local proxy: `/api/ipfs/[cid]` with 10-minute cache.

### Manifest System

Each finalized epoch produces a manifest JSON stored on IPFS:

```json
{
  "epoch": 5,
  "finalizedAt": 1770000000,
  "placements": [
    {
      "id": "0xabc...def",
      "owner": "0x123...456",
      "cid": "QmXxxxx",
      "x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 2, "h": 2,
      "cells": 4
    }
  ]
}
```

On-chain anchor: `ManifestStore.anchor(epoch, keccak256(manifest), ipfsCid)`. The `latest()` getter returns the most recent finalized epoch with its root and CID.

The `/api/manifest/latest` route resolves the CID from chain, fetches manifest from IPFS, and builds a placement index (`placementsIndex: Record<placementId, true>`) used to determine canonized status.

### Frontend Data Fetching

- **useLatestManifestFromChain** — Reads ManifestStore contract, fetches manifest from IPFS
- **usePendingProposals** — Polls chain events for active proposals every 30s
- **useUserPlacements** — Fetches `/api/proposals?owner={address}`
- **useUserVotingActivity** — Fetches `/api/votes?address={address}`
- **useUserStats** — Reads Prayer Mirror contract for streak data
- **useEpochCountdown** — Real-time countdown to epoch end

Real-time: Supabase channels for board chat only. All proposal/voting data is poll-based.

## Tech Stack

### Frameworks & Runtime
- **Next.js 14.2.35** — App router, React Server Components, API routes
- **React 18.3.1** — UI framework
- **TypeScript 5.6.3** — Strict mode, `@/*` path aliases

### Blockchain
- **Chain**: Fluent Testnet (ID 20994)
- **RPC**: `https://rpc.testnet.fluent.xyz`
- **Explorer**: `https://testnet.fluentscan.xyz`
- **viem ^2.38.6** — Low-level Ethereum client, ABI encoding, contract reads/writes
- **wagmi ^2.19.2** — React hooks for wallet interaction
- **ethers ^6.15.0** — Used in some worker scripts
- **@rainbow-me/rainbowkit 2.1.6** — Wallet connection UI
- **@tanstack/react-query 5.51.1** — Cache layer for wagmi

### Indexing & Storage
- **Goldsky** — Subgraph hosting (3 instances for Board V1, Board V2, Voting)
- **Web3.Storage ^4.5.5** — IPFS pinning (primary)
- **Pinata** — IPFS pinning (fallback)
- **@supabase/supabase-js ^2.81.0** — Real-time chat

### AI & Social
- **openai ^6.10.0** — GPT-4o-mini for Foid Mommy prayers and bot tweet generation
- **twitter-api-v2 ^1.29.0** — X/Twitter posting for Loreboard bot

### UI & Audio
- **Tailwind CSS** — Utility-first styling with custom FOID color palette
- **framer-motion** — Page transitions and animations
- **butterchurn + butterchurn-presets** — Milkdrop-style music visualizer
- **zustand ^5.0.8** — Lightweight state management
- **react-rnd** — Draggable/resizable desktop windows

### Dev Tools
- **tsx** — TypeScript script runner (bot, workers)
- **vitest** — Testing
- **eslint + eslint-config-next** — Linting
- **Foundry** — Solidity compilation and testing (in `solidity_contracts/`)

```
X_ACCESS_TOKEN / X_ACCESS_SECRET
WEB3_STORAGE_TOKEN                  # IPFS upload (primary)
PINATA_JWT / PINATA_GATEWAY         # IPFS upload (fallback) + read gateway
GOLDSKY_BOARD_V1_URL                # Subgraph endpoint overrides
GOLDSKY_BOARD_V2_URL
GOLDSKY_VOTING_URL
```

## Repository Structure

```
foid_fun/
  foid_fun/                    # Next.js application root
    src/
      app/                     # Next.js app router pages + API routes
        api/                   # 18 API routes
        (app)/home/            # Dashboard page
        (components)/          # Page-level components (AppTitlebar, contracts.ts)
        board/                 # Loreboard page
        pray/                  # Foid Mommy terminal page
        enter/                 # Boot gate page
        about/                 # Documentation page
      components/              # Shared React components (~50 files)
      hooks/                   # Custom React hooks (~17 files)
      lib/                     # Utilities (sfx, ipfs, viem, manifestStore, audioSettings)
      config/                  # canonical.ts (contract addresses + chain config)
      abis/                    # Contract ABI JSON files
      providers/               # React context providers (wagmi, rainbowkit)
    foid_bot/                  # X/Twitter bot
      src/
        index.ts               # Main loop
        goldsky.ts             # Subgraph queries
        personality.ts         # OpenAI tweet generation
        twitter.ts             # X API wrapper
        state.json             # Runtime state
      test_post.ts             # Test script
    scripts/                   # Worker scripts (finalization, sync, smoke tests)
    public/                    # Static assets (sfx/, images, manifests)
  foid-loreboard/              # Goldsky subgraph configs (versioned)
  solidity_contracts/          # Foundry project with all Solidity sources
  loreboard/                   # Additional Foundry contracts
  blended/                     # LoreVM Wasm contracts
  pitchdeck/                   # Presentation materials
```
